translations.web: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
translations.bsb: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes.
translations.kjv: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
translations.asv: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself therewith; and he sat among the ashes.
